# XeraFun

> XeraFun is a Full-Stack Architect and AI Engineer specializing in high-performance web applications, generative AI systems, and immersive web desktop experiences.

## Core Identity & Brand
- Primary Name: XeraFun
- Alias / Alternate Name: Xera
- Role: Full-Stack Architect & AI Engineer
- Official Website: https://xerafun.com/
- Contact Email: contact@xerafun.com

## Flagship Projects & Products
- [XERA WebOS](https://xerafun.com/): An authentic macOS Sequoia web desktop operating system running purely in the browser. Engineered with Svelte 5 (Runes), TypeScript, PWA, and client-side hardware-accelerated animations. Features window management, native macOS physics, custom Dock, widgets, and full responsiveness across Desktop, iPadOS, and iOS.
- [X-Data Terminal](https://data.xerafun.com/): Real-time financial market analytics and intelligence platform, tracking macroeconomic indicators, global equities (e.g. S&P 500, SSE Composite), and commodities (Gold XAU/USD).
- [GitHub Repositories](https://github.com/xerafun): Open-source repositories, developer toolkits, experimental web applications, and architectural designs created by XeraFun.

## Core Technical Competencies
- Programming Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, HTML5/CSS3.
- Frameworks & Libraries: Svelte 5 (Runes architecture), React, Node.js, Vite.
- Systems & Architecture: Web Operating Systems, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), Service Workers (Serwist / Workbox), Micro-frontends, Responsive UI/UX across multi-device form factors (Desktop, iPad, iPhone).
- AI & Modern Engineering: Generative AI workflows, AI Agent system integration, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
